items.summary: NABKISAN Finance Limited, a subsidiary of the National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD), on 1st October 2026 listed India’s first Social Bond dedicated exclusively to the Water, Sanitation and Hygiene (WASH) sector on the National Stock Exchange (NSE), Mumbai. items.title: NABKISAN Lists India’s First WASH-Focused Social Bond, Raises ₹180 Crore
